summary: Renders the "saving replay" overlay when a non-empty message string is supplied. Two paths: (1) if a saving-replay entry is found on the object, draw a static panel via F_10ParamForwarder with dimensions read from the entry, center and render the message string when the 'ftim28blk' wide-string node exists, then fill the panel surface; (2) otherwise, if a wide-string node exists at object offset +0x1538, run a ~0.45 s animation loop that draws a progress-scaled grayscale box through DelegationWrapper while elapsed time (QPC) is below 0.45 s, then render the message string centered on a nominal 800-by-600 region.

local_names.a1: object pointer; also passed as the raw pointer bits to sub_498560 via a decompiler float reinterpretation
local_names.a2: declared second parameter, never referenced in the decompiled body
local_names.a3: message string whose non-emptiness gates the whole function
local_names.v6: sub-object dereferenced from the entry at +12
local_names.v7/v8: static panel width/height read at v6+28 / v6+32
local_names.v25/v16: progress float clamped into [0,1] (clamped twice redundantly)
local_names.v19/v20/v21: truncated progress byte duplicated into the packed grayscale color word

operations.description: Entire body is skipped unless a3 is non-null and strlen(a3) is non-zero
sub_497AD0(a1, aSavingreplay00, 0) looks up the 'saving replay' string entry (global 0x005CCB00) on the object; a non-zero result selects the static-display path
Read static panel dimensions from the found entry: sub-object at entry+12, width at +28 and height at +32
GlobalAccessor_5150() retrieves the global render context object
F_10ParamForwarder(sub_object, 0, 0, ctx, 0, 274, width, height, 0, 0) forwards the ten render parameters that draw the static saving-replay panel (height literal 274)
WideStringLinkedListSearch(aFtim28blk) searches the wide-string node list for the 'ftim28blk' token (global 0x005CCAF4); a non-null result enters the caption-positioning sub-path
sub_498560(a1 pointer bits, aFtim28blk) consumes the 'ftim28blk' token with the object pointer
sub_5531F0(a3, &x, &y, 1) parses the message string into integer/float position outputs used to center the caption
Caption centered horizontally: x = 400 - parsed_x / 2, with a fixed y of 281
sub_553070(a3, x, 281, ctx) renders the message string at the centered caption position
sub_495080() yields between render steps (once in the static path, once per animation frame)
Accessor() returns the render-surface pointer, then RenderSurfaceFillCopy(ptr, 0, 274, width, height) fills the static panel background rectangle
When no saving-replay entry exists, the animated path is selected only if WideStringLinkedListSearch(a1 + 5432) finds a wide-string node on the object at byte offset +0x1538
sub_5531F0(a3, &w, &h, 1) parses the message into width/height outputs; v31 = 400 - w/2 and v30 = 300 - h/2 center the animation on a nominal 800-by-600 region
GlobalAccessor_5150() supplies the render context stored for the animation loop
Timer setup: StructZeroInit_8ba0 clears a 76-byte timer buffer, QPCTimerInitialization(1) primes the QPC subsystem, TimerResetUsingQueryPerformanceCounter resets the elapsed baseline
Animation loop repeats while elapsed <= 0.44999999 s; each iteration re-reads elapsed via PerformanceCounterDiffWithScaling(timer), so the loop runs roughly 0.45 s
Progress t = clamp(elapsed * 2.2222223, 0, 1); the 2.2222223 multiplier (~1/0.45) normalizes the 0.45 s window into a 0..1 fade, clamped twice into v25 then v16
Per-frame box geometry: width and height both 8 + trunc(t) via CRTFtol (t clamped to 0..1 so the box is 8 or 9 px), centered at (400 - size/2, 300 - size/2)

Packed color word: the truncated progress byte from CRTFtol duplicated across three bytes (low byte plus two 8-bit left shifts, fourth byte zero); with t clamped to 0..1 the packed value is 0 or 1 per byte
DelegationWrapper(ctx, x, y, w, h, color) draws the animated box each frame with the progress-derived geometry and color
sub_495080() yields between animation frames
After the loop, sub_553070(a3, v31, v30, ctx) renders the message string at the centered animation position
Final sub_495080() yield, then EmptyStub_0170(timer) tears the timer state down
Void function; control returns to the caller once either the static or animated path completes

clean_pseudocode: color = trunc(t) replicated into each of the three color bytes;
DelegationWrapper(ctx, 400 - size/2, 300 - size/2, size, size, color);
unresolved: The a2 parameter is declared in the signature but never referenced anywhere in the raw decompiled body
v28 = *(float *)&a1 is a decompiler artifact that reinterprets the a1 pointer as a float so sub_498560 receives the raw pointer bits; no floating-point arithmetic is performed on it
The progress float is clamped to [0,1] twice (into v25, then again into v16) though the two results are identical; the redundancy appears to be a decompiler artifact
Eight read-only globals (flt_59E43C, flt_59E440, flt_59E4DC, flt_59E8FC, flt_59FEC8, flt_5AC9E0, unk_7CDE00, dword_8AFE64) are flagged by packet facts but appear nowhere in the raw decompiled source

The literal 274 is used both as the F_10ParamForwarder height and the RenderSurfaceFillCopy rectangle parameter, and 281 is the fixed static caption y; their screen-space meaning is not further evidenced
